title: A reeve in default
The reeve of {other}
Dues unpaid in {other}
summary: The reeve of {other} has not paid the domain's dues. Summon them before his lordship's court.
The coffers of {other} are empty and its dues unpaid. Bring word to its reeve that the court expects them.
The reeve of {other} owes the domain. Go and say so, in his lordship's name.
offer: {other} pays nothing this season and its reeve sends excuses. Go there, {distance} {direction}, and tell the reeve to answer at court.
A reeve who does not pay is a reeve who forgets whose land it is. Remind the reeve of {other}.
I want the reeve of {other} before the court. You carry his lordship's word: go.
progress: Has the reeve of {other} heard the summons?
complete: The reeve will come to court. A word from the right mouth works wonders.
Summoned. Now we will hear their excuses in person. Well done.
They will answer at court. Good.
